archive_filename_note: The archive index counts files, not attempts, and attempt 3 is held in two files -- the gate's own copy and a redundant one made by hand. So the fourth attempt is archived under index 05. The count that matters is taken from result digests, not filenames, which is why the duplicate does not inflate the allowance; the filenames are left as they were written rather than tidied, because renaming evidence after the fact is worse than an untidy index.

attempts.terminated_by: the operator's own 590 second harness timeout, during the stress
attempts.why_not: it produced no verdict, so it yielded nothing to select on

attempts.why_it_could_not_have_passed: the stress conformed and stopped naturally at 13118 tokens against a 32000 threshold, so even with perfect delivery this instrument could only have reached not_ready_stress. The third allowance was not spent on a run that could not succeed.

attempts.why_not: it is not a delivery verdict; it is final and closes the milestone

closed.final_because: only a not_ready_delivery verdict may be superseded
closed.why: re-running with 76 stations would be adjusting the instrument until the gate passes, which is the failure this allowance exists to prevent

counted_from: the attempt archive on disk, never from memory

resets.reason: apparatus revision 1 re-derived the stress size from the token envelope the qualifying generation will demand, replacing a constant inherited from M120 that had never been re-checked after the schema was flattened. The revised gate is a different instrument, so the allowance spent against the previous one does not carry over.

rule: Only a not_ready_delivery verdict may be superseded, and at most three such attempts may be made in total. Every other verdict -- ready, a feature finding, an identity failure, enforcement failing open, a stress failure -- is final on its first occurrence and can never be re-run.
the_danger_this_bound_exists_for: Re-running until a quiet window returns ready would be selection by another name. The bound makes the number of windows tried finite and visible.
why_a_delivery_verdict_is_different: It says the route did not answer: requests exhausted their permitted retries on HTTP 429 and no completion came back. That is a delivery condition, not a capability finding, and M114's delivery discipline -- inherited through M119 -- already holds that an explicit pre-generation 429 carrying no completion and no evidence of model execution is not a scientific outcome.
